data.name: Shadow Servant
data.description: At 1st level, the puppeteer can create a shadow servant to perform simple tasks. The shadow servant is identical to an unseen servant (caster level %1), except it appears as a formless shadow. Shadow servant relies on visual components.|BardLVL
